method.goal: Convert the '388 UPGRADABLE (upper bound 376)' scoping ESTIMATE into a REAL-YIELD estimate by empirically testing whether the recorded per-muni zone_source_url endpoints actually serve queryable per-muni zone GeoJSON with a real zone-code field (source-identity candidate -> documented capturable).
method.probe: READ-ONLY WebFetch against the ACTUAL recorded zone_source_url per sample slug. ArcGIS: .../query?where=1=1&outFields=*&resultRecordCount=3&f=geojson. GeoServer WFS: /geoserver/ows?service=WFS&version=2.0.0&request=GetFeature&typeNames=<layer>&outputFormat=application/json&count=3&CQL_FILTER=id_municipalite=<id>. No capture, no deposit, no S3 write except this committed record.
method.verdict_rule: AUTOMATABLE only if a live sample actually returned a GeoJSON FeatureCollection of Polygon/MultiPolygon WITH a real zone-code attribute. NOT-AUTOMATABLE if the recorded URL does not resolve to a live queryable service. Extrapolation within a cluster is labelled an estimate.
method.anti_invention: Yield is grounded in the samples that actually returned data. goAzimut is scored 0 because ALL sampled recorded URLs failed to resolve to a live ArcGIS REST service (see cluster note), not from a URL-pattern guess.

clusters.shape: SHARED GeoServer WFS. TWO shared layers observed: evb:zonage_municipal and evb:siadmin_pzon_99_s, both filtered by id_municipalite (encoded in the recorded URL fragment). One endpoint (/geoserver/ows) serves all municipalities.

samples.zone_code_field: no_zonage_municipal (e.g. 'M2.3-1'); + id_type_zonage_municipal, description='Agroforestier de type 1', hyperlien_grille_specification (real reglement PDF page anchor)

clusters.notes: Both shared layers return per-muni Polygon geometry as application/json with a real zone-code field via CQL_FILTER on id_municipalite. Whole cluster is batch-capturable from ONE endpoint. CAVEAT: some recorded ids carry a leading zero (e.g. albertville 07025); id_municipalite is numeric in zonage_municipal but string-typed in siadmin_pzon_99_s, so the CQL literal may need to be unquoted (7025) or quoted ('07025') per layer — a trivial capture-time detail, not a blocker.

samples.liveness: www host 302 -> https://www2.goazimut.com//gis109-04/... ; www2 single-slash path = 404 Not Found ; www2 double-slash path = goAzimut MARKETING HOMEPAGE (SPA fallthrough), not ArcGIS. MapServer service root and /query both 404 on single-slash.
same pattern: 302 -> www2 double-slash -> marketing homepage

clusters.confidence: high (3 distinct instances gis109-02/04/10 all fail identically)
clusters.reason: The recorded ArcGIS REST paths do NOT resolve to a live service. www.goazimut.com 302-redirects every path to www2.goazimut.com with a literal double-slash; the double-slash path is served by the goAzimut marketing SPA (homepage HTML), and the single-slash deep ArcGIS paths (service root, layer, /query) return 404. There is no publicly reachable ArcGIS REST at the recorded zone_source_url, so f=geojson support is moot. The GIS appears to be fronted by the goAzimut viewer app rather than direct REST exposure.
clusters.notes: This drives the entire yield collapse: goAzimut is 184/388 = 47% of the UPGRADABLE pool. Reaching it would require RE-DISCOVERING the live (likely session/token-proxied) endpoint — that is source re-discovery, not source-identity replay of the recorded URL, so it is out of the source-identity method as defined. Read-only WebFetch verdict; a real browser/app context (playwright) MIGHT reach a proxied backend but was out of scope and would not be the recorded URL.

clusters.shape: Per-muni ArcGIS MapServer, path MRC0XX/0XXXX_Publique/MapServer/<layerid> ('_Publique' = public).
clusters.confidence: medium-high (1 sample verified; consistent public _Publique pattern across the 12)
clusters.notes: MapServer here DOES honour f=geojson and returns Polygon geometry with a real zone code. exceededTransferLimit=true on the 3-row sample (normal; full pull uses paging/resultOffset).

clusters.shape: SHARED MRC MapServer: all 12 slugs point to the SAME URL IntranetMRC/ZonageMunicipal/MapServer/3, filtered per-muni by Code_mun. Despite 'Intranet' in the path it is publicly queryable.
clusters.confidence: medium-high (endpoint live + geojson + per-muni Code_mun filter present)
clusters.notes: One endpoint serves all 12 via Code_mun. Zone-code field is Disposition_spéciale ('AF8'); GROUPEUSAGE is the usage group — confirm at capture time that Disposition_spéciale is the intended zone identifier rather than a special-disposition flag.

clusters.shape: Esri ArcGIS Online hosted feature layers. Some per-muni (Zonage/FeatureServer/N), some shared MRC layers filtered by CODE_MUN/MUN.
clusters.confidence: high (5/5 AGOL feature services tested returned public GeoJSON with a zone-code field; f=geojson is native to Esri hosted feature layers)
clusters.notes: Covers services.arcgis.com (7), services6 (6), services8 (3), services9 (1), www.arcgis.com (2). The 2 www.arcgis.com entries are portal item URLs (not directly a FeatureServer) and would need item->service resolution; counted inside the 19 but flagged as needing one resolution step.

untested_small_hosts.note: Not sampled (budget: 3-5 per cluster). Endpoint-class pattern given; yield UNCERTAIN, excluded from the confirmed floor and only partially credited in the upper of the realistic range.

portneuf.blob.core.windows.net.assessment: possibly a static geojson/file capture, untested

untested_small_hosts.reminder: 6 of the 388 are pdf-plan (georeference, NOT source-identity) per the scoping; some of the other-http single hosts above overlap that category.

consolidated_yield.interpretation: REAL yield is roughly HALF the 376 upper bound. The collapse is driven almost entirely by goAzimut (184 slugs = 47% of the pool) whose recorded ArcGIS REST URLs do not resolve to a live queryable service. The remaining big cluster, geoCentralis WFS (147), is cleanly batch-capturable from one endpoint, and every other tested cluster (altusquebec, victoriaville, AGOL) is automatable. The floor of ~190 is verified-by-sample; the upper of ~205 credits the ~14 untested small hosts partially (some are custom/pdf/blob and may not be source-identity-capturable).

caveats: READ-ONLY WebFetch probing. WebFetch upgrades http->https and hands back cross-host redirects; it is not a full browser. goAzimut's NOT-AUTOMATABLE verdict is for the RECORDED zone_source_url replayed as-is (the source-identity contract); a session/token-proxied backend reachable only via the goAzimut app was not probed and would be re-discovery, not source-identity.
Per-cluster verdicts rest on 1-5 samples each; single-sample clusters (altusquebec, victoriaville) are labelled medium-high confidence and extrapolate a consistent URL/platform pattern.
geoCentralis leading-zero id_municipalite may need string-quoted vs unquoted CQL depending on the layer's field type (numeric in zonage_municipal, string in siadmin_pzon_99_s).
exceededTransferLimit=true appears on the 3-row samples (expected); full per-muni capture uses paging (resultOffset/resultRecordCount) — not a blocker.
The 14 untested small hosts are excluded from the confirmed floor; only partially credited in the upper bound of the realistic range.
